sources.title: XHToken/Spark-X2.5-4B-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Spark-X2.5 is a compact, general-purpose language model for conversation, writing, translation, reasoning, coding, tool use, and agentic workflows. It uses a hybrid attention architecture, supports a native context length of up to 1M tokens, and covers more than 200 languages. For its architecture, training methods, benchmark results, fine-tuning, and citation, see the Spark-X2.5-4B.
